bridgeRouteRisk.summary: sfrxUSD is native on Ethereum and Fraxtal; 25 other tracked EVM deployments are FraxZero LayerZero OFTs, and Solana, Aptos, and Movement are non-EVM OFT representations with documented direct connectivity to both Fraxtal and Ethereum. Current 2026-08-16 reads confirm the Fraxtal lockbox as the hub peer, the Ethereum lockbox as a canonical-side authorized minter, a common representation ProxyAdmin, and 3-of-6 chain-local OFT owner Safes for the six previously reviewed EVM routes. Frax documents that OFTs burn on the source and mint on the destination through LayerZero, while the lockboxes provide the external-lock route; these representations are not direct Frax balance-sheet liabilities. Endpoint DVN configuration, enforced options, rate limits, and lockbox redemption caps remain unresolved.

protocols.name: FraxZero LayerZero OFT hub
protocols.note: Frax states that non-Ethereum/non-Fraxtal deployments are OFTs, which mint on receipt and burn on send; all OFTs and lockboxes are managed by a 3/6 multisig per chain.
